The define-hybrid (n32 engine inside the CDC leaf) is refused by the reviewed_gray_fifos checker and s1a census FAILs (max 8512, engine fan-out), so the engine moves to its own single-clock tile qkd_hr_ingest_eng (native32 netlist) and this shell carries only the 3-family CDC: u_hx / u_ox / u_cx payload in three reviewed dual-clock SRAMs (u_cx back from the 64-slice form to ONE 1-bit afifo + shadow pointers + u_cxm), kept select copies (<=15 b chunks) for ox_w / die-face capture / t_d, 3-part cx_w on engine done copies, engine reset = 2 dedicated u_rsi leaves (18/19).
